messages:
asha_partnerships: Quick sync — vendor just confirmed hardware courier ETA for partner booth demos. Need final handoff plan + speaker baggage handling.

miguel_events: thanks. ETA and tracking? also rehearsal window today?

asha_partnerships: Courier ETA 10:30am Thu (local). Tracking CNTR-778234. Customs docs uploaded to shared drive: https://drive.redwood/example-swag-customs. Rehearsal at 2pm PT today (30m).

priya_devrel: 2pm works for me. Can we get a short run order? I want to cue the demo between speaker intro and Q&A.

sam_hwpartner: Confirmed we’ll hand over 2 loaner racks + 3 dev kits. Hardware lead (Rae) will travel with 1 checked case and 1 carry-on with spare SSDs. Swag: 400 sticker packs + 150 hoodies arriving separate by courier.

asha_partnerships: Excellent. Two critical asks: (1) courier needs chain-of-custody signoff at pickup and delivery — use this template: `COC_FORM_HW_V1.pdf` (in drive). (2) Speaker baggage — we need airline tags + backup kit manifest.

zach_ops: For the demo fallback: if on-site HW fails, fall back to marketplace-hosted image. I pushed a golden AMI and a docker image. Copy of fallback run commands for on-call:
```
# fallback to cloud image
ssh -i /secrets/demo_key ubuntu@marketplace-demo-host
docker pull redwood/demo-golden:stable
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/demo-golden:stable
```

sam_hwpartner: Good to have. One more: please confirm power/cable checklist for the booth. I’ll bring adaptors but need host PDs.

miguel_events: Booth power: 2x 20A circuits (north wall). We added a labeled cable box. I'll DM venue contact.

priya_devrel: Streaming: can someone confirm RTMP endpoint + backup OBS scene? Also need mic check 15m before go.

asha_partnerships: RTMP: rtmp://stream.redwood/live/partner-track + backup: rtmp://backup.stream.redwood/live. OBS scene name: "partner-demo-main". Priya, I added you as co-host.

courierbot: Shipment CNTR-778234 status: IN TRANSIT -> OUT FOR DELIVERY (ETA 10:27am). Customs cleared.

priya_devrel: Minor ask — please include one printed quickstart (2-sided) per dev kit in the checked case, and label each kit with QR linking to the runbook.

asha_partnerships: Will do. QR links: https://docs.redwood/demo-quickstart. Sam/Rae will affix.

zach_ops: Also added a tiny k8s manifest to the runbook in case we need to spin up a multi-node fallback: `k8s/demo-fallback.yaml` (permissions updated).

sam_hwpartner: Got it. Courier got a COC signature on pickup. I’ll bring extra SATA cables and a mini HDMI dongle.

miguel_events: Rehearsal 2pm — agenda: 2:00 mic/video check, 2:05 host intros, 2:10 demo failover test (cloud fallback), 2:20 live demo flow, 2:28 Q&A prep, 2:30 wrap. Please be on time.

asha_partnerships: Final note: swag routing — hoodies via local courier (separate AWB: HD-33211) arriving at 9am. I'll ping shipping team to stage at green room. :package: :tshirt:

priya_devrel: Thanks. I’ll prepare a 1-slide callout on the marketplace fallback to reassure customers if hardware latency spikes.

asha_partnerships: Perfect. If no issues I’ll mark this as ready — anyone object?

sam_hwpartner: All green from my side.

zach_ops: No objections. I’ll watch logs during rehearsal.

miguel_events: Good — see you at 2pm.

courierbot: Shipment CNTR-778234 status: DELIVERED to Loading Dock B at 10:23am. Signed: "Rae (sam_hwpartner)"
